title: Attack on Titan
subtitle: Freedom found in the jaws of despair
description: In a world where humanity lives behind massive walls to protect themselves from man-eating Titans, young Eren Jaeger vows to exterminate them after his city is breached.
quotes: If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win.
The only ones who can change the world are those willing to give up everything.
I am free. I will keep moving forward until my enemies are destroyed.
